top.h1: Digha to Darjeeling, Puri to Port Blair. One office, one price, no surprises.
top.p: We plan the whole trip: train or flight, hotel, car, sightseeing. You get one written quote per person before you pay anything. Office in Gariahat, open six days a week.

photo.alt: Tea gardens on rolling hills near Darjeeling at sunset, with a family walking along the ridge

packages.h2: Five trips we run every month.
packages.p: Prices are per person on twin sharing, in a standard hotel. Children under 5 travel free; 5 to 11 pay 60%.

itinerary.h2: What you do each day, and what each hotel grade costs.
itinerary.p: Pick a destination. Standard means a clean 2-star hotel with AC. Deluxe means a 3-star hotel with breakfast and dinner.
itinerary.sub: Leaves Kolkata every Friday and on request for groups of 8 or more.
itinerary.td5: Private car instead of bus (per car, 4 seats)
itinerary.rate-note: Weekend and holiday dates cost ₹600 more per person.
itinerary.sub2: Train from Howrah overnight. Hotel within walking distance of the sea.
itinerary.rate-note2: Rath Yatra week: hotel prices double, book 3 months ahead.
itinerary.sub3: Train to New Jalpaiguri, shared car up to Darjeeling. Warm clothes needed October to March.
itinerary.td15: Deluxe, private car, breakfast and dinner
itinerary.td17: Add Mirik and Kurseong day (per person)
itinerary.rate-note3: Pujo week and Christmas week: add ₹2,000 per person.
itinerary.sub4: Permits for Tsomgo and Nathula are arranged by us. Carry two passport photos and a voter card or Aadhaar.
itinerary.td21: Deluxe, private car, breakfast and dinner
itinerary.td23: Add 2 nights Lachung and Yumthang valley
itinerary.rate-note4: Nathula permit costs ₹300 extra per person and is not refundable if the pass is shut.
itinerary.sub5: Flights from Kolkata to Port Blair are booked separately and cost ₹9,000 to ₹16,000 return depending on the month.
itinerary.td27: Deluxe, private cruise ferry, breakfast and dinner
itinerary.rate-note5: Best months: November to April. Ferries are often cancelled in the monsoon.

items.span: AC bus from Esplanade at 7 am. Check in by 1 pm. Evening at Old Digha beach.
Car to Mandarmani and Talsari. Marine aquarium on the way back. Night at the hotel.
Morning at New Digha beach and market. Bus leaves 2 pm, Kolkata by 7 pm.
Overnight train from Howrah. Reach Puri early morning, check in, rest. Evening beach and Jagannath temple darshan.
Full-day car to Konark Sun Temple, Chandrabhaga beach and Ramchandi.
Chilika lake at Satapada, dolphin boat ride, Raghurajpur craft village.
Morning free for the market. Afternoon train back to Howrah.
Overnight train from Sealdah. Car from NJP, reach Darjeeling by afternoon. Mall Road walk.
Tiger Hill sunrise at 4 am, Ghoom monastery, Batasia Loop, then zoo, ropeway and tea garden.
Toy train joyride to Ghoom. Afternoon at Peace Pagoda and Happy Valley tea estate.
Car down to NJP, train home. Optional Mirik lake stop on the way.
Train to NJP, car to Gangtok (5 hours). Evening on MG Marg.
Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir. Nathula pass if the permit is granted (Wednesday to Sunday).
Gangtok local: Rumtek monastery, Banjhakri falls, Tashi viewpoint, Ganesh Tok, flower show.
Day trip to Namchi, Char Dham replica and Samdruptse statue. Or a free day.
Car to NJP, train home.
Fly to Port Blair. Corbyn's Cove beach, Cellular Jail light and sound show.
Ferry to Havelock (Swaraj Dweep). Radhanagar beach for sunset.
Elephant beach by boat, snorkelling included. Evening free.
Ferry to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep). Bharatpur, Laxmanpur and the natural bridge.
Ferry back to Port Blair. Ross Island and North Bay.
Fly home. Hotel check-out at 10 am, airport drop included.

included.h2: What the price covers, and what it does not.
included.p: The same list applies to every package above. We write it on the quote too.

services.h2: Not going on a package? We still do the small jobs.
services.p: Walk in with your ID and dates. Most tickets are done while you wait.

items.p: IRCTC bookings including Tatkal from 10 am sharp. Flights on every airline, with the fare shown to you before we book.
items.fee: ₹40 per train ticket · ₹200 per flight ticket

items.p: Hotels we have stayed in ourselves, at Digha, Puri, Darjeeling, Gangtok, Shillong and Port Blair. Confirmation on WhatsApp within an hour.
items.fee: No fee. We earn from the hotel.

items.p: AC sedan or 7-seater with driver, from Kolkata or at the destination. Fuel and driver's food included; tolls and parking extra.
items.fee: Sedan ₹2,800 per day · 7-seater ₹3,800 per day (8 hours, 80 km)

items.p: Para clubs, school reunions, office outings. 20 to 60 people, one bus, one bill. We send a tour manager with groups of 30 or more.
items.fee: Group rates from 10% below the per-person price

items.p: We fill the passport form, book the PSK slot and check your documents. Tourist visas for Thailand, Singapore, Dubai, Nepal and Bhutan permits.
items.fee: Passport form ₹500 · visa service ₹1,500 plus the embassy fee

items.p: Covers medical bills, lost baggage and trip cancellation. Needed for Andaman ferries and strongly advised for the hills.
items.fee: From ₹180 per person for a 6-day trip

chardham.h2: Char Dham, 11 nights 12 days, from Haridwar.
chardham.p: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath in one trip, May to June and September to October. Our driver has done the route for nine seasons. Pony or palki at Kedarnath and Yamunotri is booked on the spot and paid by you.
chardham.p2: The yatra registration, hotel at every halt, a Bengali cook who travels with the group, and a pick-up at Haridwar station are all included. Train from Howrah to Haridwar is booked separately so you can choose your class.

photo.alt: Kedarnath temple with snow-covered Himalayan peaks behind it

booking.h2: Four steps. The first two cost nothing.

items.p: WhatsApp or walk in. Give the destination, travel dates, number of adults and children, and whether you want train or flight.
Within one working day you get a quote per person, with the hotel name, the train number and the included and not-included list.
UPI, bank transfer or cash at the office. We book the tickets and the hotel the same day and send you the confirmations.
Balance is due 7 days before departure. You get a printed itinerary, driver's number and our 24-hour number for the trip.

More than 30 days before travel: full refund minus what the railway or airline keeps. 15 to 30 days: we keep 25% of the package. Under 15 days: we keep 50%. Under 72 hours: no refund, because the hotel does not refund us either. Every refund is paid within 7 working days.
Under 5 years, sharing the parents' bed: free, you only pay the train or flight ticket if a seat is needed. 5 to 11 years with an extra bed: 60% of the adult price. 12 and above: adult price.

items.summary: What if the train ticket is waitlisted?
items.p: We book the day the window opens, 60 days ahead, so most tickets confirm. If a ticket is still waitlisted 7 days before, we tell you and offer a bus, a different train, or a full refund of that package. We never make you travel on a waitlisted ticket.

items.summary: Can I change the dates or the hotel?
items.p: Yes. Every package can run on your own dates for 2 people or more. You can pick a different hotel from our list, or name one you know; we quote the difference. Honeymoon rooms and ground-floor rooms for elderly travellers are arranged on request.

items.summary: How do I pay, and do I get a receipt?
items.p: UPI, bank transfer, debit card at the office, or cash. Every payment gets a printed receipt with a GST invoice. We do not take payment on any personal UPI number; the name on the UPI is always Bhraman Bilash Tours and Travels.
Took my parents to Puri in March. The hotel was the one in the quote, the car came on time every day, and when Baba felt unwell the driver took us to a doctor without being asked.
